description: Na₂Lu₃Te₄(O₄I)₃ is Zircon-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four O and four I atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.89 Å. There are a spread of Na-I bond distances ranging from 3.30-3.39 Å. There are two inequivalent Lu sites. In the first Lu site, Lu is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.46 Å. In the second Lu site, Lu is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.44 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O and one I atom. There is one shorter (1.89 Å) and two longer (1.90 Å) Te-O bond lengths. The Te-I bond length is 3.44 Å. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O and two equivalent I atoms. There are two shorter (1.89 Å) and one longer (1.91 Å) Te-O bond length. There is one shorter (3.45 Å) and one longer (3.47 Å) Te-I bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Lu, and one Te atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaLu₂Te tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Lu, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Lu and one Te atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Lu, and one Te atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaLu₂Te tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Lu, and one Te atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLu₂Te tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Lu and one Te atom. There are two inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. In the second I site, I is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent Na and three Te atoms.
